_doc: Defaults used ONLY by the 3D reconstruction when the plan does not specify a value. Every default use is recorded in the 3D metadata.

ground._doc: Floor coverage (topology/ground.py): parts of the building outline (closed over notches up to 2 x close_m) not covered by rooms, walls or columns get a ground slab and a validation warning.

_doc_balcony: Balcony walls (classification 'railing'): a low solid parapet of balcony_parapet_height_m with glass above it up to railing_height_m.
